scripts.build: node packages/tokens/build.mjs && npm run build:react && npm run build:site
scripts.test: node tests/e2e.mjs && node tests/states.mjs && node tests/nontext.mjs && node tests/contracts.mjs && node tests/new-components.mjs && node tests/react-site.mjs && node tests/react-advanced.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write packages/ui-react apps/site packages/contracts apps/api apps/web test vitest.config.ts tests scripts docs/padroes .github .oxlintrc.json commitlint.config.js
scripts.typecheck:react: npm run typecheck -w @will-labs/ui-react && npm run typecheck -w @will-labs/site
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages/ui-react apps/site packages/contracts apps/api apps/web test vitest.config.ts tests scripts docs/padroes .github .oxlintrc.json commitlint.config.js
scripts.lint: oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings packages/ui-react/src apps/site/src packages/contracts/src apps/api/src apps/web/src test vitest.config.ts packages/tokens tests scripts commitlint.config.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:react && npm run typecheck:product
scripts.typecheck:product: npm run typecheck -w @will-labs/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @will-labs/api && npm run typecheck -w @will-labs/web
